prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: third high-fidelity desktop composition option for an approved visual direction, 1440×900 landscape.
Input image role: Image 1 is the visual-system reference for palette, typography character, wayfinding plates, icon style, central illustrated globe and production craft. Preserve that identity; do not copy its layout verbatim and do not carry over any logo rendering.
Primary request: Recompose the «Туту План Б» route-plan screen in the same BRIGHT WAYFINDING PAVILION world, testing a VERTICAL JOURNEY THEATER composition. This is an operating interface, not a poster.
Structure: slim header; route title «Екатеринбург → Санкт-Петербург» above the scene; a huge clean illustrated globe centered and occupying about 55% of the viewport with one coral route arc; a narrow left wayfinding mast holds the three configuration choices «Надёжный», «Сбалансированный», «Бюджетный» plus the 87% resilience measure; a narrow right journey mast is a vertical numbered sequence with outbound transport, hotel and return, one yellow branch labeled «План Б»; a single low summary dock spans the bottom with duration, transfers, demo price 84 600 ₽ and the coral booking handoff. No dashboard navigation.
Signature interaction implied: choosing a stage on the right moves a location spotlight across the globe while the bottom summary updates; the active stage plate slides inward toward the planet.
World: current Tutu-adjacent daylight white/cool-blue ground, deep ink navy, clear blue, vivid violet, warm coral, sunny yellow risk, mint success. Controls read like contemporary public wayfinding plates and station signage, not generic cards. The planet remains the unmistakable center.
Exact text where legible: «Туту План Б», «Екатеринбург → Санкт-Петербург», «Надёжный», «Сбалансированный», «Бюджетный», «План Б», «Демо-данные», «Устойчивость 87%», «84 600 ₽», «Перейти к оформлению».
Constraints: simplified illustrated geography, not satellite terrain; preserve high contrast and production usability; no copied logos, no stock bento grid, no large app sidebar, no dark neon mission control, no glassmorphism, no fake photography, no watermark, no poster composition. Show enough of each journey stage to make the screen operational.
